decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the options by filtering for high-rated speakers across premium, mid-range, and budget categories, excluding accessories like cases and charging cords, as well as non-Bluetooth devices like the Sonos (WiFi) or the Jabra speakerphone. My consideration set includes the premium Harman Kardon, the reliable Bose SoundLink, the solid mid-tier BOGASING, the high-performing budget Raymate, and the aesthetically pleasing INSMY Retro. I ultimately chose the Harman Kardon Onyx Studio 6 because its reviews consistently highlight exceptional bass and audio clarity ('crisp clear music with a ton of thump') which justifies the higher price point for a high-quality home audio experience.
